adapter_wiring: dispatchExecution returns effect_state on EVERY path: denied -> effect_none; unknown/escalated/timeout/extract-fail/verify-fail/emission-rejected -> effect_unknown; verified completed/failed -> effect_unknown (explicit, never clean success)
artifactBase carries effect_state on every persisted artifact (step-8 terminal artifact: effect_unknown)
recordVerifiedResult threads effect_state into the canonical event metadata (additive; defaults effect_unknown)
terminalOutcome(COMPLETED) THROWS without an explicit effect_state (construction-level guarantee); FAILED defaults to effect_unknown
effectHold(record, reason): caller-owned UNKNOWN->HOLD transition for reconcile-vs-retry; pure; refuses non-unknown sources
unknownOutcome() carries effect_state: effect_unknown by construction
